title: Orbital witherskull Cannon
description: Similar to Orbital strike cannon but spawn wither skull intead of tnt capable of breaking obsidian
body:
# **Orbital Witherskull Cannon**

Unleash devastating orbital destruction with the **Orbital Witherskull Cannon**! This datapack summons thousands of dangerous wither skulls high above the target, creating a massive bombardment that rains down in perfectly spaced concentric rings. The result is an enormous explosion capable of carving huge craters and even destroying **obsidian**, making it one of the most powerful weapons available in vanilla Minecraft.

The cannon is activated using a **Fishing Rod**, making it quick and easy to deploy during survival adventures, multiplayer battles, or creative demonstrations.

![Orbital Strike Using wither skulls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8758fc0cad57b216ba68411cc21eb5dd459db50.png)

## Commands

### Target where you are looking

```
/function orbital:give/wither_aim
```

Gives a Fishing Rod that summons the orbital witherskull cannon at the block you are looking at.

### Target your current position

```
/function orbital:give/wither
```

Gives a Fishing Rod that summons the orbital witherskull cannon directly at the your current current location.

## Features

* Massive orbital bombardment using dangerous wither skulls
* Thousands of wither skulls arranged in a circular strike pattern
* Creates huge craters with spectacular explosion effects
* Powerful enough to destroy obsidian
* Easy activation using a Fishing Rod
* Multiplayer compatible

Prepare for total devastation and call down an orbital strike unlike anything you've seen before!
